source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (ODbL). Free, keyless. No FortyGuard credential used.
projection: local equirectangular about the bbox centre; metres
caveat: OSM footprints are crowd-sourced; heights are usually absent, so the solver's building height stays a stated assumption rather than a measurement. Condenser bank positions are NOT in OSM and remain an assumption placed on the downwind face.
